description: List the texts your Ringback line sent in a time range: missed-call text-backs, your replies from the dashboard and automatic replies, with delivery status as the phone reported it, the median time from call to text-back, and up to 50 most recent texts with their wording. Needs a personal Ringback access token, created by the business owner in Ringback (Settings, AI assistants) and sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Read-only; reads only that business's own call and text log.

range.description: Time range: "today" (since midnight in the business's time zone), "7d", "30d" or "90d" (that many days back from now). Default "7d".

name: my_texts_sent
title: Texts my Ringback line sent
